app_fee.value: The first application fee is $70; each later application within 12 months is $25.
app_fee.quote: The first application fee is $70.00; any application after, within a 12 month period is $25.00.

fee_waiver.value: No need-based fee waiver; only McNair Scholars and UM TRIO undergraduates get one.
fee_waiver.quote: There are no need-based application fee waivers.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School's pages do not mention the GRE; each program sets its own rule.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum is 4.5 on the new scale for tests taken after 21 January 2026.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL IBT (Home Edition also accepted) - For exams taken after January 21st, 2026 | Minimum score: 4.5

english_waiver.value: An Indian degree waives the test only if its institution's primary language of instruction was English and the university gets a verification. The exempt-country list (Policy A8.300) could not be checked.
english_waiver.quote: If you received a degree from an institution whose primary language of instruction was English, we can accept a verification of language of instruction in place of an English proficiency exam.

notes: Catalog pages with the full graduate policy (A8.200/A8.300 exempt-country list) returned HTTP 502, so India's status on that list is unverified. The undergraduate exemptions page was not used. Department-level rules are in the program records.
